description: The ready WakeHuBERT 'sveglia' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.47).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: OmniVoice clips with no reference speaker, one seed per clip, each checked against a speech recogniser transcript, and the training clips of TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-sveglia (CC BY 4.0); LibriSpeech train-clean-100 (CC BY 4.0) mixed in as background babble; negatives from wakeforge datasets/train.csv, the even half of an AudioSet noise sample, and Italian speech from Common Voice 17 train (CC0) and FLEURS train (CC BY 4.0) cut into 1.5 s windows.
